sources.title: DeepSeek | Into the Unknown
sources.snippet: DeepSeek is an AI research company focused on building world-leading general artificial intelligence. We develop and open-source frontier LLMs including DeepSeek-V4, DeepSeek-R1, and DeepSeek-Coder. Chat with DeepSeek AI or integrate via API.

sources.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash API - Demo - DeepInfra
sources.snippet: DeepSeek V4 Flash is an efficiency-focused MoE model with 284B total parameters (13B active) and a 1M-token context window. It's tuned for fast inference and high-throughput use cases while still holding up on reasoning and coding tasks.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 · Models - modelscope.ai
sources.snippet: It has the same model structure as DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark, i.e. it comes with a speculative decoding module attached. DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 outperforms DeepSeek-V4-Pro (Preview) on benchmarks listed below despite its far smaller activated parameter count, and is broadly competitive with the strongest proprietary models available.

sources.title: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash
sources.snippet: See Benchmarking DeepSeek-V4-Flash for the full results. Background DeepSeek-V4-Flash is a 284 billion parameter sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model from DeepSeek-AI, with only 13 billion parameters active per forward pass.
